findings.text: Asking ₹40,000. New price is ₹86,990 (as of 10 Nov 2026). A used laptop often sells for ₹26,097 to ₹65,243. This is a sample range, not a price check.
Battery health is 65%. Below 70% usually means a replacement soon.
No bill or invoice. Warranty claims and proof of ownership become hard.

blocks.note: These are checks, not a verdict. I do not say whether to buy.

blocks.title: Check in person before paying
items: Meet in a public place and test the laptop before paying.
Check the serial number on the body matches the bill.
Look at the battery report, hinge, keyboard, ports and screen.
Sign out of all accounts and reset the laptop in front of you.
Pay only after the checks, and keep a written receipt.
